title: Ye Kiski Hogayi Pamaal Laash Maqtal Me
body:
Yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
Abhi toh dulha banayagaya tha ibne hasan, bani thi Fatima kubra abhi abhi dulhan, utha yeh shor ke ada mein aaya tashna dahan, gira jo ghode se pamaal hogaya hai badan, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
Sada ye dete the Akbar ke aaiye baba, ghira hain lakho mein Qasim hasan ka mahe laqa, har ek simt se hota hai pyaase par hamla, pukarta hain madad ko meri tum aoo chacha, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
Hussain tham ke dil ko chale hain laashe par, hain saat gaiz mein Abbas aur Ali Akbar, jo pounche laashe pa Sarwar toh tha ajab manzar, bikhar ke laasha padha tha zamin-e- karbal par, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo dekhi bhai ki tasweer khoon mein galta, tamam jism pa ghodo ki tapou ke the nishaa, tadap ke kehte the Qasim chacha tere khurbaa, mai aasaka na madad ko nikal gayi teri jaan, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
Thi muntazar dare khaima pe Zainab-e-muztar, utha ke laye hain laasha Hussain kandhe par, pouhanch ke khaime pa kehte the shahe jinno bashar, hua hai teerou se zakhmi hasan ka laqte jigar, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
Jo dekha bete ka laasha tadap gayi maadar, lipat ke kehti thi khurbaan maa tere dilbar, balaye leti thi laashe ke gird phir phir kar, pachade khati thi dulhan toh hota tha mehshar, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
Ye bain karti thi laashe pa gham zada dulhan, kise dikhaon mein haal apna dil ka ibne hasan, utar na paya mere haat se abhi kangan, mein bewa hogayi meraujad gaya jeewan, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Dulhan ke bain se khaime mein hota tha kohraam, jo sar ko peet ke karti thi aaho zari tamam, utho hum aaye hain laashe pa lo hamara salaam, dilasa dete the beti ko shahe arshe muqaam, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein
Aye mossavi yehi roroke kehti thi dukhiya, batao kis ke sahare mujhe yahan chooda, na sar se sehra utar paya hogayi bewa, ajib shaadi ka mujhko mila hai ye tohfa, yeh kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal mein..
